scope: Theorem 5.3 (Strong integration of every unitary module) of the manuscript “Strongly rational unitary vertex operator algebras and conformal nets” (preprints/Strongly-rational-unitary-vertex-operator-algebras-and-conformal-nets-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 280 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5f09142bda3ec3d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let V be simple, unitary and strongly rational. Every grading-restricted unitary V -module M has a unique compatible family of normal representations πM J : AV (J) −→ B(HM ) such that, for every homogeneous v ∈ V and g ∈ C∞ c (J), πM J (︂ Y V (v, g) )︂ = Y M (v, g). (5.4) Equality here includes the domains of the closed affiliated operators. The canonical Virasoro action of this net representation is the integrated module Virasoro action; in particular its rotations are eitL0 with the module’s conformal-energy normalization.
